title: Optimize the comparator before claiming a learned speedup
text: Deterministic positive-cost observations leave a used test constant on all reachable descendants. The remaining hypothesis mask and budget suffice for the exact dynamic program in this setting. RV22-K compared against the improved cached integer solver and found no robust end-to-end advantage from learned adaptive widths. A valid follow-up should charge feature computation, reranking, and fallback search and compare with the strongest exact implementation, using fresh roots.

title: Separate observation, activation, and admission
text: A deterministic sparse probe can miss a recurring root if repetitions occur only between probes. In RV22-Q the constructed alias stream exposed this weakness. Jittered probes recovered reuse but did not beat always-key delayed admission on that cohort. Test a deliberate schedule-alias workload as well as ordinary recurrence. A digest observation is a hint to investigate a certificate, not authority to reuse it.

title: Know which information a compactification discards
text: For two classes and m binary tests, all class-conditioned marginals through order k have rank 2 times the sum of binomial(m,j) for j from zero through k. High-order Walsh parity components are invisible to these marginals. Equal low-order marginals can coexist with distinct optimal research decisions. A coarse key is therefore a screening invariant. Require exact canonical equality and policy replay for cache authorization.

title: Measure capacity cliffs with actual key bytes
text: DGK/1 reduced key bytes by 78.9 percent relative to the original JSON and 49.8 percent relative to integer-coded JSON in the fresh capacity grid. The benefit came from fitting additional recurring certificates under the logical cap. Key compression alone does not establish lower process memory or faster CPU time. Measure policy payload, metadata, lookup cost, and eviction under matched trust semantics.

title: Account for the cost of repeated verification
text: In an equal-size cyclic working set larger than cache capacity, ordinary LRU may miss every recurrence. A delayed freeze policy retains C certificates after the second observation and gets (R-2)C hits over R complete cycles. Net savings are C*((R-2)*(s-h)-v) before monitor costs, with s cold solve cost, h hit cost, and v verification cost. Check whether reuse can repay verification before spending resources.

title: State the assumptions behind a competitive bound
text: The rent-or-buy rule has a two-competitive cost bound for constant per-key costs, zero logical hit cost, accurate history, no eviction, and a mandatory solve at purchase. An exact finite cache oracle showed that freeze and simpler LRU variants can outperform payback admission on overflow workloads. Keep the theorem restricted to its model; unknown termination and eviction change the optimization problem.

title: Carry successful components and preserve failures
text: The campaign integrated bounded exact DP, independently checked replay, binary canonical keys, and an optional in-process root cache. Learned admission and fingerprint refinement remained experimental. Freeze verified interfaces when further controller tuning fails to beat simple controls. A capability ledger should identify the tested input domain and verification authority, along with the evidence that a proposed component did not earn promotion.

title: Transfer gains need difficulty and compute controls
text: The native curriculum audit verified 96 roots and 816 action records. Separate synthetic residual heads improved over one-step search on standard/frontier roots. Two-step search still won, and the recurrent head had no established advantage over the near head-MAC-matched feedforward control. On the foundation cohort the learned advantage disappeared. Keep evaluator-only labels separate and measure actual realized net utility and compute.

title: Diagnose negative transfer at the family boundary
text: At 64 inspected masks, robust discrimination transfer solved 3 of 32 roots optimally, versus 16 for analytic ranking. Portfolio transfer was near analytic, and proof obligations were at ceiling. A pooled observation mean failed all 32 full paired-gate certificates and changed eligibility on four roots; equal-root arithmetic passed all 32. Use family-specific error analysis rather than a pooled score to choose the next experiment.

title: Exploit the structure of research constraints
text: For error tolerance e, require 2e+1 separating predictions for every mechanism pair. If exactly the deficit number of separators remain, every such separator and its dependency closure is mandatory. If too few remain, the branch is infeasible. With admissible lower bounds and targeted pair branching, the tested solver certified all 72 roots under a 64-mask budget. Logical inspections and CPU cost are distinct measures.

title: Produce certificates a separate checker can replay
text: A feasible incumbent gives an upper bound. A proof DAG closes every alternative branch using cost, availability, mandatory dependencies, or an admissible relaxation. The checker independently recomputes branch coverage and pruning witnesses. All 569 emitted complete proofs in RV23-C replayed successfully. Seven availability-only searches reached the optimum without completing the proof under the tight cap. An optimum found by search and a certified optimum are different evidence states.

title: A stronger bound has an invocation cost
text: RV23-D proved that residual closure-union states can be deduplicated exactly. The cached quotient reduced its own OR-attempt work on ordinary and shared-control cases, yet direct combination enumeration was faster. The cheap forced solver was the fastest mean at full budget in every cohort; the control floor certified all fresh roots within 64 masks. Refine bounds lazily only if their expected pruning benefit justifies construction and checking overhead.
